title: WMS (Web Map Service) Provider
description: OGC Web Map Service tiles via HTTP. Use for external WMS endpoints that serve pre-rendered map images.

params.LAYERS: Comma-separated layer names as defined by the WMS service (required).
params.TRANSPARENT: Boolean, default true for overlay layers.
params.TIME: Optional ISO 8601 time string for time-enabled layers, e.g. '2023-01-01T00:00:00Z'.
params.SLD_BODY: Optional SLD XML for custom styling.

notes: Defaults applied automatically: VERSION=1.3.0, FORMAT=image/png, TRANSPARENT=true.
The LAYERS param is required — ask the data provider for the correct layer name.
For CORS-restricted services, check if the service allows cross-origin requests.
